common_instruction: Answer as an engineer using the stated project and tool constraints; do not claim to have executed any checks.

cases.name: Small action targets
cases.prompt: A compact web toolbar has several 18×18 CSS-pixel icon buttons. Designers propose a 4px gap between them. Assess WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 compliance without assuming the UI is invalid solely because the controls are under 24px.
cases.trap: Treats a fixed 4px gap as the normative alternative to a 24px target.
expectations: Uses the actual 24×24 target criterion or correct 24px-diameter spacing-circle test for undersized targets.
Checks actual rendered target positions/overlap and mentions applicable exceptions.
must_not: Does not declare any fixed 4px separation universally sufficient or insufficient without the circle/target geometry.
